decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks remain closely tied to the firm's dental thermoforming materials knowledge, so accumulated production and customer feedback should support further refinement rather than withdrawal.

The PETG thermoforming blank sits in the firm's core dental laboratory materials domain, where its existing know-how, certified quality systems, and sales channels make continued commercialisation highly likely.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are still a related extension of the firm's earmold and hearing-care capabilities, and its learning from adjacent products and channels makes retention more likely than exit despite somewhat higher uncertainty than core dental materials.
